llms:
Formula band = first k with time <= bandBreaks[k], else 0xffffffff (no band), so band k holds (bandBreaks[k-1], bandBreaks[k]] and a time exactly on a break is in the lower band, the rule of GPUNetworkReachability and GPUNetworkIsochrones. Unreached, unsnapped or non-finite demand times (>= 3.0e38; unreached demand is written as +Infinity) get no band. time = min(cost[source] + fraction * forwardCost, cost[target] + (1 - fraction) * reverseCost) on the snapped edge (each direction only when its cost is >= 0), and also the direct along-road cost |ahead| * forwardCost or reverseCost to every facility snapped to the same road, so demand on a facility road is not routed through the end nodes.
